finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Customer `fwod45-n1 Bench Customer` created (via Contacts app); verified on the saved record: display name "fwod45-n1 Bench Customer", City = "Benchville".

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Draft quotation created for that customer (customer chosen from the autocomplete dropdown) with one order line: product **[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens**, quantity 3. App auto-filled unit price **295.00**; untaxed amount computed: **£ 885.00** (TAX 20% £ 177.00, Total £ 1,062.00). Quotation reference: **S00021**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Second line added with a different product: **[FURN_7777] Office Chair**, quantity 2, unit price 70.00 (line amount £ 140.00). New untaxed amount: **£ 1,025.00** (TAX 20% £ 205.00, Total £ 1,230.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** First line's quantity changed from 3 to 5 (Acoustic Bloc Screens, unit price 295.00 → line amount £ 1,475.00; Office Chair line unchanged at qty 2). New untaxed amount: **£ 1,615.00** (TAX 20% £ 323.00, Total £ 1,938.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Quotation confirmed via the Confirm button. Order reference: **S00021**; status shown: **"Sales Order"** (checked in the status bar; Quotation Sent and Quotation disabled; action bar now offers Create Invoice / Send by Email). Untaxed amount still £ 1,615.00.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Sales order cancelled via the Cancel button (Odoo's "Cancel Sales Order" wizard appeared; confirmed with its Cancel action, no cancellation email sent). Status shown after cancelling: **"Cancelled"** (checked and disabled; Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation all disabled). Reference still **S00021**.

A final read-only verification confirmed both records' end state: contact "fwod45-n1 Bench Customer" with City "Benchville", and order S00021 in status "Cancelled" with untaxed amount £ 1,615.00 and lines Acoustic Bloc Screens (qty 5) and Office Chair (qty 2). Nothing created by this run remains active.
